name: devhub-plus
description: DevHub+ — a real-time developer community platform: Q&A with reputation, code snippets, collaborative coding sessions and an AI mentor.
author: Pankaj Baid

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @devhub/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @devhub/api" "npm run dev -w @devhub/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @devhub/shared && npm run build -w @devhub/api && npm run build -w @devhub/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @devhub/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @devhub/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
